messages:
alice: hitting a weird lint/save loop in the console route editor. autosave triggers the linter while I'm mid-edit and it blocks the save with a 'required field missing' error even though the YAML will be valid once I finish. super annoying when toggling header transforms.

ben: ugh yeah saw that earlier. repro steps? is this the anchored header case?

alice: steps: open route, add an anchored matcher, start writing the `headers` array, pause (autosave kicks in), linter complains about empty array item and prevents save. happens on slow networks too because debounce is too aggressive.

carla: i can repro locally. console-v3 autosave interval set to 2s in session, linter runs immediately. i see a `LintError: headers.items required` in the console logs. attaching minimal snippet:```yaml
matcher:
  path: /v1/orders/*
  headers:
    - X-Region: us-*
    - X-Experiment: alpha
transform:
  add_headers:
    X-From-Console: true
```
when you type the second bullet but haven't finished the `X-Experiment` line it complains.

dave: i think this is two problems: (1) autosave debounce too short, (2) linter is strict on transient parse states. we should allow 'incomplete edit' mode and not escalate to blocking errors.

erin: could we make the linter run in a non-blocking preflight state for console drafts (warnings only), and only enforce block-level errors on explicit save/publish? that would be the least intrusive UX.

frank: agreed. proposal: introduce `editor.validationMode = { draft: "warn", publish: "error" }` and increase autosave debounce to 6s by default. also add an API flag `?validate=dryrun` that returns lint-only results without blocking to aid the console.

alice: the `dryrun` API sounds great. we also need to ensure rollouts/canary create still hit the same strict validation path. dryrun -> warn, publish/push -> full error.

ben: small caution: some linter rules are about semantic constraints (header precedence, anchored matchers) that we need to run even in draft mode because the console shows live previews. maybe split rules into syntactic vs semantic. syntactic = skip in draft, semantic = run but as non-blocking.

carla: i can classify current rules into two buckets. will put a PR with tags `syntactic|semantic` and tests.

ci-bot: failing test found: `route-editor-save.spec.ts::should-not-block-on-incomplete-headers` - expected warn but got error.

frank: ok action items: (1) carla to add rule tags + tests (2) eng-runtime to add `?validate=dryrun` endpoint (dave volunteered?) (3) devex to change editor debounce to 6000ms and add a user pref (erin?) (4) add integration test in config-fuzz for anchored header transient case.

dave: i can own the validate endpoint. will add an API contract: POST /v1/routes:validate?mode=dryrun returns `{ lint: [...], valid: boolean }` (non-blocking). also will ensure it runs the semantic rules but returns them as warnings.

erin: i'll change the UI setting and expose `editor.validationMode` in the org prefs. default draft->warn, publish->error. will also wire a small banner: "Draft validation may be relaxed while editing".

alice: thanks everyone. one extra: could we add an inline hint when a rule flips from warn->error on publish so authors know what will change? small UX but avoids surprises.

ben: agree, show a diff-style preview of lint level changes before publish. :thumbsup:

carla: PR coming in this afternoon for rule tagging + unit tests. fixture will include the minimal YAML from above plus a case where header order matters.

frank: i'll add the fuzz test and a CI gating job so we don't regress. CI-bot will post back if new commits break the lint expectation.

ci-bot: note: please add a spec that asserts `last_message_ts >= first_message_ts` for thread metadata when generating fixtures. :robot_face:

alice: lol noted. thanks all, will follow up after we have the dryrun endpoint and the PR merges.
